episodes.title: Intro to Psychology
episodes.description: Introduce psychology's meaning, origins, and influential figures in its development.

episodes.title: Psychological Research
episodes.description: Compare research methods and the practices psychologists use to limit experimental bias.

episodes.title: The Chemical Mind
episodes.description: Explore neurons, chemical signaling, and the nervous system's role in bodily reactions.

episodes.title: Meet Your Master – Getting to Know Your Brain
episodes.description: Tour the brain's major structures and consider what injury reveals about their functions.

episodes.title: Sensation & Perception
episodes.description: Distinguish sensory information from perception while exploring how vision works.

episodes.title: Homunculus
episodes.description: Use the sensory homunculus model to understand how the body is represented in the brain.

episodes.title: Perceiving is Believing
episodes.description: Explore how the mind turns sensory input into meaningful perceptions.

episodes.title: Consciousness
episodes.description: Investigate consciousness, attention, and the risks of dividing focus while driving.

episodes.title: To Sleep, Perchance to Dream
episodes.description: Explore brain activity during sleep and ways sleeping processes can malfunction.

episodes.title: Altered States
episodes.description: Look beyond fictional portrayals to explore hypnosis and other altered experiences of consciousness.

episodes.title: How to Train a Brain
episodes.description: Explore learned responses through Pavlov's work, Skinner's experiments, and other approaches to learning.

episodes.title: The Bobo Beatdown
episodes.description: Examine learning through observation using the famous Bobo doll experiment.

episodes.title: How We Make Memories
episodes.description: Explore different processes for forming and recalling memories and what happens when they are damaged.

episodes.title: Remembering and Forgetting
episodes.description: Investigate forgetting, inaccurate recollections, and the risks of trusting memory uncritically.

episodes.title: Cognition: How Your Mind Can Amaze and Betray You
episodes.description: Explore thinking, communication, problem-solving, and the mind's unexpected complications.

episodes.title: Language
episodes.description: Investigate how brains produce language and make shared meaning possible.

episodes.title: The Power of Motivation
episodes.description: Compare theories and evolutionary perspectives that explain why people act.

episodes.title: The Growth of Knowledge
episodes.description: Explore schemas, stages of cognitive development, and scaffolding in children's learning.

episodes.title: Monkeys and Morality
episodes.description: Use developmental experiments to examine attachment, anxiety around separation, and emerging morality.

episodes.title: Adolescence
episodes.description: Explore adolescence through the development of identity and individuality.

episodes.title: Rorschach & Freudians
episodes.description: Consider personality theories and the appeal and controversy of Rorschach testing.

episodes.title: Measuring Personality
episodes.description: Explore competing methods for describing personality and understanding the self.

episodes.title: Controversy of Intelligence
episodes.description: Examine intelligence testing, different accounts of intelligence, and its troubling historical uses.

episodes.title: Brains vs. Bias
episodes.description: Investigate bias in intelligence assessments and how it limits interpretation of test results.

episodes.title: Feeling All the Feels
episodes.description: Explore what emotions are and the roles they play in human life.

episodes.title: Emotion, Stress and Health
episodes.description: Connect emotional responses and stress with their effects on physical health.

episodes.title: Let’s Talk About Sex
episodes.description: Explore sexuality, gender identity, hormones, and influential research into sexual behavior.

episodes.title: Psychological Disorders
episodes.description: Trace changes in responses to psychological disorders and the people behind those developments.

episodes.title: OCD & Anxiety Disorders
episodes.description: Distinguish casual labels from the experiences of obsessive-compulsive conditions, anxiety, and panic.

episodes.title: Depressive and Bipolar Disorders
episodes.description: Explore possible causes and lived effects of depressive and bipolar mood conditions.

episodes.title: Trauma & Addiction
episodes.description: Investigate trauma's effects on the brain, its relationship with addiction, and approaches to treatment.

episodes.title: Schizophrenia & Dissociative Disorders
episodes.description: Clarify differences between schizophrenia and dissociative conditions and address common misunderstandings.

episodes.title: Eating and Body Dysmorphic Disorders
episodes.description: Introduce eating-related and body-image conditions and the importance of understanding them.

episodes.title: Personality Disorders
episodes.description: Explore personality-related conditions and their possible biological, psychological, and social influences.

episodes.title: Getting Help – Psychotherapy
episodes.description: Learn what psychotherapy can involve, who provides it, and what seeking assistance may look like.

episodes.title: Biomedical Treatments
episodes.description: Explore the development of biomedical approaches and how they can work alongside psychotherapy.

episodes.title: Social Thinking
episodes.description: Consider how situations and personal characteristics influence behavior, including a famous prison experiment.

episodes.title: Social Influence
episodes.description: Investigate obedience, groupthink, and social pressures that shape action and inaction.

episodes.title: Prejudice & Discrimination
episodes.description: Examine psychological approaches to stereotyping, prejudiced beliefs, and discriminatory behavior.

episodes.title: Aggression vs. Altruism
episodes.description: Compare explanations for aggression and helping behavior, including exchange, frustration, and bystander effects.
